title: The Lobby
story: The elevator opens southwest of the indoor garden, and Ivo, the reception lead, asks the new engineer to visit four desks before the first ticket can be assigned. Two workers beside the arrival walk the same tiny loop at the same moment, an early hint that the building is over-managed.

steps.objective: Step out of the elevator and listen to Ivo's welcome.
Walk once around the garden: right, up, left, down.
Visit the north, west, south and east desks in that order.
Walk to Ivo without prompts, then back to reception.
Optional: repair the folded form in the south lobby.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: A welcome popup covers the lobby. Tap Caps once to close it; holding Caps and pressing a second key is not the way.
success_criteria: Escape is observed while the popup is open
The popup closes and the map is usable again

task.prompt: Welcome popup (modal over the lobby) with the keyboard inset showing Caps.

steps.expect: Escape key event while the popup is open
rejects: any arrow key event (that is Caps held plus H, J, K or L)

feedback.ArrowLeft: Left Arrow observed: that is Caps held plus H. To close the popup, tap Caps with no second key.
feedback.ArrowRight: Right Arrow observed: that is Caps held plus L. To close the popup, tap Caps with no second key.
feedback.ArrowUp: Up Arrow observed: that is Caps held plus K. To close the popup, tap Caps with no second key.
feedback.ArrowDown: Down Arrow observed: that is Caps held plus J. To close the popup, tap Caps with no second key.
feedback.other: Observed output does not close the popup. Tap Caps once and let go.

task.retry_note: Retry is instant: a wrong output shows its own name in the feedback line and the field resets for another try. Nothing is lost.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Walk once around the garden, one direction at a time: right, up, left, down. Each leg ends on a lit floor marker.
success_criteria: Right Arrow (Caps + L), Up Arrow (Caps + K), Left Arrow (Caps + H) and Down Arrow (Caps + J) are each observed and move the avatar one cell
All four lit markers are reached in order

task.obstacles: none in the loop bands (x8-9, x17-18, y4-5, y12-13)
task.wrong_direction: walking the other way is allowed and counted as exploration; the leg only completes at its marker
task.feedback: Each press shows the observed arrow in the effect line (Step east, Step north...).

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Visit the north, west, south and east desks in that order. Floor markers show where each desk is, not which keys to press.
success_criteria: Each of the four desk stops is reached in order
All four arrow directions are observed along the way

task.markers: desk glow only; no arrow or keycap cues

terminal_scenes.task_summary: At the west desk a label prompt asks for the desk's name. Caps may still be held from walking: release it, then type the word.
success_criteria: No navigation event (Option + Right) was left in the field

task.prompt: Desk label (west desk): type the label.
rejects: Option + Right (nav + W) instead of w

feedback.Alt+ArrowRight: Option + Right observed: that is Caps held plus W, a word jump. Release Caps, then tap W.
feedback.ArrowLeft: Left Arrow observed: Caps is still held. Release Caps, then type the label.
feedback.other: That is not the next letter of west. Next letter shown below the field.

steps.expect: w, e, s, t typed with Caps released

terminal_scenes.note: Triggered when the avatar reaches the west stop inside o01-four-stops.

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Ivo has gone to the north desk: walk to him with no markers, then back to reception when he returns. A badge reminder popup appears on arrival.
success_criteria: The avatar reaches Ivo at the north desk, then at reception
Up, Left, Down and Right are all observed
The reminder popup is closed with Escape (tap Caps)

popup.text: Badge reminder: please collect your badge at the printer.

task.markers: only Ivo's conversation marker; no floor markers, no keycap highlights

terminal_scenes.task_summary: Optional glitch repair: a folded form in the south lobby shows the word lobb. Move to the end of the word with Caps + L, release Caps, type the missing letter.
success_criteria: The glitch snaps into register and becomes a plain sheet of paper

task.prompt: Folded form glitch, turn 1 of 1 (untimed, instant retry).

steps.expect: four Right Arrow events (Caps + L) put the cursor after lobb
y typed after Caps is released

feedback.other: The cursor is not at the end yet. Hold Caps and press L four times, then release Caps.

terminal_scenes.note: Appears after the Lobby route; no seal, artifact or gate depends on it.

state_changes.before: Turnstile barred, Ivo waving on a script, two workers pacing the same loop in step beside the arrival, Pace arrows around the garden.
state_changes.after: Turnstile open to the mailroom, Ivo nodding instead of waving, garden markers gold, a folded form wandering the south lobby.

pace_copy.text: Approved route: follow the arrows. Efficiency is a pleasant habit.

review_notes: At 1366x768 (x4, 1280x720 stage) the garden loop is 2 to 3 cells wide and the camera follows the avatar at screen (160,100), so the avatar stays right of the keyboard inset (x 4-147) except where the camera clamps at the map's west and south edges (rows 13 and below, west of x9). The first leg therefore runs along row 12, where the avatar's feet stay at screen y 100 (above the inset's top edge, y 103). The arrival cell (2,12) and Ivo's greeting at (3,11) are on or above that row, and the elevator call panel is on the wall above the elevator for the same reason. No keyboard-inset conflict is documented for this level.
